corpus_name: Toledo School of Translators Registry (12th - 13th Century)
historical_patrons: Archbishop Raymond of Toledo (Don Raimundo de Sauvetât, in office 1125–1152)
King Alfonso X of Castile (El Sabio, r. 1252–1284)
description: Systematic documentation of Arabic scientific, mathematical, medical, and philosophical treatises translated into Latin and Castilian in Toledo.

key_innovations_transferred: Detailed illustrations and specifications of 200+ surgical instruments
Internal suturing with catgut (kedi bağırsağı ipliği)
Lithotomy technique (mesane taşı ameliyatı)
Systematic cauterization and surgical hemostasis
translations.impact_in_europe: Textbook at Montpellier, Bologna, and Paris universities for over 400 years; cited extensively by Guy de Chauliac and Lanfranc of Milan.

translations.translator: Gerard of Cremona & John of Brescia
key_innovations_transferred: Universal astrolabe (saphaea / azafea) operable at any latitude without interchangeable plates
Precise coordinates of 84 astronomical observation points across the Mediterranean
Discovery and measurement of the proper motion of the solar apogee
translations.impact_in_europe: Standard planetary tables in Western Europe until the Alfonsine Tables (1270s); established base meridian calculations.

translations.latin_title: Gebri Filii Affla Hispalensis de Astronomia Libri IX
key_innovations_transferred: Geber's Theorem for solving right-angled spherical triangles
Rigorous analytical critique of Ptolemaic planetary order regarding Mercury and Venus
Systematic derivation of the sine rule without relying on Menelaus' theorem
translations.impact_in_europe: Directly incorporated by Regiomontanus in De Triangulis Omnimodis (1464), laying the basis for early modern European trigonometry.

translations.work_arabic: الشروح الكبرى والوسطى على أرسطو (كتاب النفس، ما بعد الطبيعة، السماء والعالم)
translations.latin_title: Commentaria Magna in Aristotelem (De Anima, Metaphysica, De Caelo)
key_innovations_transferred: Pure Aristotelian rationalism freed from Neoplatonic distortions
Concept of the unity of the material intellect (monopsychism debate)
Methodological separation between demonstrative rational proof (burhān) and dialectical theology
translations.impact_in_europe: Sparked the rise of Latin Averroism at Paris and Padua universities; prompted the Condemnations of 1277 and Aquinas's Summa Theologiae.

translations.latin_title: Liber Teisir sive Rectificatio Medicationis et Regiminis
translations.translator: Jacob Frances (into Hebrew) & John of Capua (into Latin)
key_innovations_transferred: Animal experimentation for validating surgical interventions (tracheotomy on goats)
Detailed pathological differentiation of pericarditis and pleurisy
Parasitological identification of the scabies mite (it-mite)
translations.impact_in_europe: Published in multiple Venice incunabula (1490, 1496, 1514) together with Averroes' Colliget (Kulliyyāt).

key_innovations_transferred: Homocentric spherical cosmology replacing Ptolemaic epicycles with spiral motions
Dynamic physical approach to celestial kinematics
translations.impact_in_europe: Sparked vigorous debates among Roger Bacon, Robert Grosseteste, and was cited by Nicolaus Copernicus in De revolutionibus orbium coelestium.

key_innovations_transferred: Concept of human mind as a blank slate (tabula rasa) acquiring knowledge through sensory empiricism and rational deduction
Harmony between solitary natural reason and revealed religion
translations.impact_in_europe: Direct philosophical precursor to John Locke's empiricism and the Enlightenment philosophical novel genre.
